chunks.arabic_text: ٤٢ - نَصْرُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ، مِنْ أَهْلِ بَلْخَ. غَالٍ.

translations.en: 42 – Naṣr ibn al-Ṣabbāḥ, Abū al-Qāsim, from the people of Balkh. A ghālī.
translations.ur: ۴۲ - نصر بن الصباح، ابو القاسم، بلخ کے لوگوں میں سے۔ غالی۔
translations.tr: 42 – Nasr b. es-Subh, Ebu'l-Kasım, Belh ehli. Gali.
translations.fa: ۴۲ - نصر بن الصباح، ابوالقاسم، از اهالی بلخ. غالی.
translations.id: 42 – Naṣr bin al-Ṣabbāḥ, Abū al-Qāsim, dari penduduk Balkh. Seorang ghālī.
translations.bn: ৪২ - নাসর ইবনু আস-সাব্বাহ, আবুল কাসিম, বালখের লোক। গালী।
translations.es: 42 – Naṣr ibn al--Ṣabbāḥ, Abū al-Qāsim, de la gente de Balkh. Un ghālī.
translations.fr: 42 – Naṣr ibn al-ṣr ibn al-Ṣabbāḥ, Abū al-Qāsim, originaire de Balkh. Un ghālī.
translations.de: 42 – Naṣr ibn al-ṣr ibn al-Ṣabbāḥ, Abū al-Qāsim, aus den Leuten von Balkh. Ein Ghālī.
translations.ru: 42 – Наср ибн ас-Саббах, Абуль-Касим, из жителей Балха. Гали.
translations.zh: 42-纳绥尔·本·萨巴赫，阿布·卡西姆，来自巴尔赫人。加利。

en.summary: This entry identifies Naṣr ibn al-ᴻabbāḥ, a narrator from Balkh, noting his kunya (Abū al-Qāsim) and classifying him as a 'ghālī' (one of the Ghalat sects who exaggerated the status of the Imams).

key_terms.غَالٍ: Ghālī, a member of the Ghalat sect known for exaggerating the status of the Imams

tr.summary: Bu giriş, Belh'li bir râvî olan Nasr b. el-Ṣabbâh'ı tanımlar, künyesini (Ebû'l-Kâsım) belirtir ve onu 'gâlî' (İmamların mertebelerini abartan Ghalat mezheplerinden biri) olarak sınıflandırır.
